ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; surface consists primarily of low-intensity black pixels (>90%) with high-intensity white/beige clusters localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous low-intensity dark region; two distinct high-contrast white geometric clusters are mapped to the far-left and far-right distal lobe vertices.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is distinct and clearly divides the fluke into two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge shows low-amplitude serrations; right lobe presents higher frequency of jagged pixel peaks compared to the relatively smooth boundary of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer edges, sweeping symmetrically upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular white/beige pixel clusters localized specifically at the tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified organic clusters (barnacles) present at both distal extremities of the fluke.
